title: Somnath Mandir Darshan
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing

scenes.prompt: Close-up devotional darshan of the Somnath Shivling, dark stone Shivling in the middle of the frame, white bilva leaves, marigold garlands and a silver cobra hood above, a lit brass diya beside it, sacred sanctum, soft golden glow
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the Shivling stays still and serene, the soft golden glow gently pulses, a few petals drift in the foreground

scenes.prompt: A grand white-stone Chalukya-style Hindu temple with a tall shikhara and a saffron flag, standing on the Arabian Sea shore at sunset, calm waves, golden evening light, no people
scenes.tts: ये मंदिर गुजरात के प्रभास पाटन में, समुद्र किनारे है।
scenes.sub: Ye mandir Gujarat ke Prabhas Patan mein, samudra kinare hai.
scenes.animate: the sea waves roll softly and the saffron flag flutters gently in the evening breeze

scenes.prompt: Twelve small glowing Shivlings arranged in a circle of soft golden light on a dark starry sky above a temple silhouette, devotional illustration, no people
scenes.tts: बारह ज्योतिर्लिंगों में, सबसे पहला इन्हीं को माना जाता है।
scenes.sub: Barah Jyotirlingon mein, sabse pehla inhin ko mana jata hai.
scenes.animate: the small lights glow and twinkle softly

scenes.prompt: Close-up of the Somnath Shivling with a crescent moon above it, dark stone Shivling in the middle of the frame, white flowers, bilva leaves and glowing diyas in the foreground, sacred sanctum
scenes.tts: हर हर महादेव! ॐ नमः शिवाय।
scenes.sub: Har Har Mahadev! Om Namah Shivaya.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the Shivling stays still, the diya flames glow and flicker softly

scenes.tts: कल फिर नया दर्शन। लाइक, शेयर, सब्सक्राइब करें। जय सोमनाथ!
scenes.sub: Kal phir naya darshan. Like, Share, Subscribe karein. Jai Somnath!
